Indian Army NCC Special Entry Scheme 58th Course Recruitment 2025 – Full Details

Join Indian Army (Govt. Of India) has release notification for the NCC Special Entry 58th October 2025 Batch SSC Recruitment on the official website of Indian Army. Any candidate who is interested to fill this form, they should check eligibility, age limit & must read the Full Notification Before applying for the Army NCC Special Entry Scheme Recruitment 2025. Those Candidates Are Interested in the following recruitment can apply online from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 February 2025
  • Last Date : 15 March 2025
  • Course Start On : October 2025

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : 0/-
  • SC, ST, Female : 0/-
  • No Application Fee

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
